title: Gut-liver axis in liver pre-metastatic niche formation: immune networks, microbial, and metabolic and emerging therapeutic opportunities.
snippet: The liver is a leading target for distant metastasis across multiple cancer types, and liver metastasis invariably portends poor prognosis.
